title: Onchain Agents — the scored, daily-updated index of the crypto agent stack
description: A daily-updated, machine-readable index of the onchain agent ecosystem: frameworks, MCP servers, wallet infrastructure, payment rails, data tools, and registered live agents, each with an evidence-based openness/activity/verifiability score (Sato Score — not a safety, quality or returns grade), liveness signal, and verification status. Rendered from the public Sato Hub export (https://satohub.ai/api/export/index.json). Each weekly release carries that day's index.json and index.csv.
notes: Scores and liveness are informational signals derived from public evidence, not endorsements, safety verdicts or financial advice. Catalog data CC-BY-4.0; attribution: data by satohub.ai.
